_comment: Arcane materials and furniture, whatever mod they come from. Entries from other mods are written as {"id": ..., "required": false} so the tag still loads when that mod is absent, rather than dropping the whole tag and taking the enchanting room's arcane signal with it. Iron's Spells' workstations - the inscription table, the scroll forge, the arcane anvil - are deliberately not here: each is the core its own room scores directly, and a block in both would count twice in the same room.
